n_fmt <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = " ")

# Introduction

## Purpose

This document summarises the IMR bottom-trawl survey indices for `r sp` (*`r cfg$SPECIES_LATIN`*) in `r area_label` (stock `r cfg$STOCK_CODE`). `r cfg$PURPOSE`

<!-- Describe the index products (total biomass, length-based, assessment index) and their model structure from config.yaml. -->

## Documents

The index calculation is documented in the files listed in @tbl-documents. Each document is reproducible from the IMR Biotic database and `config.yaml`.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-documents
tibble::tribble(
  ~Document, ~Content, ~Status,
  paste0(stock, "-1-summary"), "This summary: purpose, overview and main results", "In progress",
  paste0(stock, "-2-survey-selection"), "Stock area, haul filter, survey and cruise-series selection, gear and timing", "Draft",
  paste0(stock, "-3-data"), "Station-level and length-based model inputs, prediction region and data checks", "Draft",
  paste0(stock, "-fishable-length"), "Derivation of the length threshold of the length-based product (docs/background/stock-background)", "Draft",
  "Model fit", "First feasible sdmTMB model and prediction grid", "Not started",
  "Model validation", "Mesh, random-field structure, fixed effects, family and grid selection; retrospective", "Not started",
  "Index report", "Final indices and assessment hand-off files", "Not started"
) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Documents of the index calculation.")
```

## Use of generative AI

This document and the associated analyses were created with researcher-supervised generative AI (<confirmed AI models>), following the [index-wise](https://github.com/DeepWaterIMR/index-wise) and [wise-writing](https://github.com/DeepWaterIMR/wise-writing) knowledge packs of the [Fiskwise](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/fiskwise/) ecosystem. AI was used to write code, compile data and draft text. The authors designed the study, specified and checked the analyses, and reviewed, edited and approved the AI-assisted content, for which they take full responsibility. This version has not yet been reviewed by the authors.

# Data

The indices are based on `r n_fmt(nrow(dt))` research bottom-trawl hauls from `r dplyr::n_distinct(dt$missionid)` surveys in `r area_label`, `r min(dt$year)`–`r max(dt$year)`, of which `r n_fmt(sum(dt$biomass > 0))` caught `r sp` (@tbl-summary-surveys). The selection is described in [`r stock`-2-survey-selection](`r stock`-2-survey-selection.html).

```{r}
#| label: tbl-summary-surveys
dt |>
  dplyr::group_by(`Cruise series` = cruiseseries) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Years = paste0(min(year), "–", max(year)),
                   Hauls = dplyr::n(), `Positive hauls` = sum(biomass > 0),
                   `Fishable-positive hauls` = sum(biomass_fishable > 0),
                   .groups = "drop") |>
  knitr::kable(caption = paste0("Hauls by cruise series used for the ", sp, " indices."))
```
